limitations: Only explicit values in the bundled theme include chain are captured.
Registered VS Code defaults, extension-contributed defaults, and user customizations are not captured.
Alpha values are source colors, not runtime-composited pixels.
Missing and null colors are not replaced with invented defaults.

baseline.syntaxPolicy: Syntax has a separate generator and native-editor report. Ordered reference syntax rules are not scored in this UI color evaluation.

experiment.fitting: Explicit Light 2026 anchors with light-specific shared families, opacities and selectors; no per-token numeric residuals.
experiment.errorDefinition: Euclidean OKLab distance multiplied by 100; NOT CIEDE2000.
experiment.primaryMetric: Raw, unpremultiplied source RGB converted to OKLab. Alpha is not included in deltaE.
experiment.withinToleranceDefinition: Percentage of generated colors whose raw deltaE <= tolerance; this rate does not test alpha or contrast. RGB black/white endpoints are canonical; no threshold epsilon is added.
experiment.alphaDefinition: Absolute difference in alpha on [0,1], reported independently; exactMatchPercent requires equal alpha.
experiment.renderedMetric: Secondary approximation: encoded-sRGB source-over, then Euclidean OKLab x 100. Each palette uses its own explicit state/subsystem background and an explicit editor fallback where needed.
experiment.renderedLimitations: No runtime layer tree is available. Background choices are heuristics; nested overlays, CSS effects, and actual compositing space may differ. Composition is quantized to 8-bit hex at each layer. Missing backdrops are listed, not invented.
experiment.percentileDefinition: Linear interpolation between sorted sample values at (count - 1) * quantile.
experiment.emptyStatistics: Zero samples produce numeric zeros and a 0% success rate, not a claim of perfect fidelity.
experiment.contrastDefinition: WCAG relative sRGB luminance. Text target 4.5:1 and illustrative focus-indicator target 3:1; missing pairs are omitted and transparent pairs are approximated.
experiment.acceptance: No quality acceptance is asserted. Human review in the actual VS Code UI is required.
experiment.preservedStatistics: Preserved workbench colors, unresolved/null entries, unscored supplemental tokens, syntax rules, and semantic token styles never inflate generated fit statistics.
experiment.semanticPolicyNote: Info defaults to an accent/foreground link or remembered custom seed. Warning/Error and Added/Deleted/Modified stay independent. Added/Deleted drive chat counters; edited files follow Modified. Prominent status items share primary-button fills/readable text/hover. Suggestion text/icons/matches use explicit text colors independent of Quick Pick/button text. Inline-code foreground follows the accent with a 4.5:1 contrast guard against its unchanged background. Scrollbar/minimap thumbs and scrollbar shadows retain fixed opacities independently of Overlay opacity. Inactive selections cap opacity; interactive generation also protects code text. Classic and pinned Modern counterparts are always modeled; supported missing IDs are unscored and nulls stay unresolved. Personality switches default off: active accent text at Primary foreground lightness, bounded to 0.2-0.9 for chromatic accents before contrast adjustment, with native decoration precedence; accent tint across nonsemantic overlays and opaque interaction fills, with neutral painted chroma capped against active selection at current opacity on the region backdrop while retaining alpha/lightness; quieter 35% tint on scrollbars/minimap/shadows/grips; Neutral 7 brackets; native status fills from accent/resolved Color 2/quiet surfaces. Semantic overlays retain their hues. These variants are not native reconstruction. This baseline has all switches off and preserves debug/remote statuses, conflicts, ignored files, terminal ANSI and unrelated statuses.
experiment.knownResidualNote: chat.slashCommandBackground and chat.slashCommandForeground remain generated from shared accent families. Their source blue palette differs from the default teal accent. Remaining color/alpha errors are reported for human review, not hidden by preservation.

complexity.fitting: Explicit Light 2026 anchors with light-specific shared families, opacities and selectors; no per-token numeric residuals.
complexity.fixedRuleCountMeaning: One rule per color transform family and per opacity transform, plus linked Info lightness, inactive selection contrast, four overlay tint constants, two active-text lightness bounds and the shared active-item/inline-code text contrast target; semantic selectors are counted separately.
complexity.semanticSelectorCountMeaning: Ordered severity/change and UI selectors, preservation patterns, Modern counterpart aliases, optional active-item/status assignments, four opaque interaction-surface patterns, quiet structural tint pattern, fixed scrollbar opacity policy, inline-code contrast guard, and one preserve-unknown fallback. Light also keeps canvas-derived interaction fills at normal surface strength.
complexity.supplementalPolicy: Generate supported severity/change, suggestion-text, Modern UI counterpart and active-item tokens absent from the explicit reference. Stateful status tokens are emitted only when enabled. Count missing tokens separately and exclude them from fidelity statistics. Explicit null values stay unresolved.
complexity.unknownPolicy: Preserve source values and exclude them from generated fit statistics.

formulas.background: Structural layers use L = background.L + sign(foreground.L - background.L) * amount * surfaceSpread; keep background a,b. Light selection, active and hover fills use surfaceSpread 1, independent of signed structural separation, so inverted layers do not erase state cues and large separation does not over-darken them. Borders and accent/status backgrounds remain independent.
formulas.foreground: L = background.L + (foreground.L - background.L) * amount; keep foreground a,b. Muted text amounts (<1) scale by mutedContrast.
formulas.border: Signed borderStrength scales neutral border lightness offsets around the canvas. Zero matches canvas RGB; negative reverses the foreground direction. Foreground-derived border a,b also pivot around the canvas. Alpha, clear borders, and accent borders are unchanged.
formulas.accent: Light-specific accent offsets keep links/focus at the accent and darken button hover instead of brightening it.
formulas.onAccent: Text on generated accent fills selects opaque black or white, whichever has higher WCAG contrast with the gamut-mapped sRGB accent background. This is independent of the primary foreground input.
formulas.info: Linked Info adds 0.02 OKLCH lightness to the Light accent/foreground, preserving hue and limiting chroma only for sRGB. Custom stays unchanged.
formulas.source: Use the resolved severity/change source. Light validation backgrounds use a quieter 0.08 canvas/source mix and borders use the source directly. Diff word opacity is 0.15 in Light; other change semantics remain shared.
formulas.alpha: Fixed opacity; multiply non-opaque opacities by overlayOpacity and clamp to [0,1], except scrollbar/minimap thumbs and scrollbar shadows, which retain their distinct fixed opacities.
formulas.inlineCode: Inline-code foreground starts at the accent hue, chroma and lightness. Reuse the accent-text contrast search to adjust lightness/gamut only as needed for 4.5:1 against the unchanged textPreformat background. Explicit null colors remain unresolved.
formulas.inactiveSelection: Preserve generated RGB, including optional tint; reduce inactive-selection alpha only when needed for 4.5:1 primary/code text contrast after sRGB compositing on canvas. Test both encoded alpha and VS Code's two-decimal CSS alpha. If the canvas already fails, never reduce its existing contrast. Choose the highest safe 8-bit alpha at or below requested opacity. Other selection states and syntax colors remain unchanged by the guard.
formulas.personality: Default-off switches: active text starts at Primary foreground lightness with the accent hue/chroma, limited to gamut. Chromatic accents bound that preferred lightness to 0.2-0.9 so nearly black/white primary text retains room for visible color; contrast may adjust it further. Gray accents retain Primary foreground. Native file decorations retain precedence. Nonsemantic opacity-controlled colors share a tint: L moves 65% toward accent L and C is min(accent.C * 0.65, 0.14), gamut-limited at the accent hue. Opaque selected/inactive-selection/activity/hover fills participate too, retaining their existing lightness. Neutral interaction fills cap painted chroma to the shared active-selection tint at the current Overlay opacity over their region backdrop, including native CSS alpha rounding and a floor for existing backdrop color. This prevents opaque/high-opacity inactive fills from becoming much more saturated than active ones; source alpha/lightness are preserved. The cap follows opacity changes without suppressing the stronger active tint. Scrollbar/minimap sliders, shadows and resize grips keep the quieter 35% tint. Accents below C 0.01 leave colors unchanged. Alpha remains exact except the existing inactive-selection safety cap; opaque surfaces stay opaque while their saturation cap follows active selection strength. Semantic severity/change/preserved colors keep their meaning. Resolved Neutral 7 optionally replaces all six bracket levels. Status fills use accent/resolved Color 2/quiet surface for native normal/debug/no-folder states; remote items remain separate.
formulas.clipping: Clamp OKLab/OKLCH lightness to [0,1], then culori OKLCH-to-sRGB gamut mapping and 8-bit hex quantization.

model.exceptionMeaning: Preserved explicit workbench colors, excluded from all generated error statistics.
